behavior: A portal part drops an attribute that names a prop only the internal portal declares. With `portal-owner-role` on Dialog.Portal, the owner element has no role. With `in-place` on Popover.Portal, the popup stays in its container. Base UI passes all props except `keepMounted` from Popover.Portal to FloatingPortal. FloatingPortal reads `portalOwnerRole` from them, although Popover.Portal declares no such prop.
